1.en: Then God spoke to Moses directly.

2.en: that they take for Me an raised-offering
from every man whose soul is generous

3.en: And this is the raised-offering which you shall take from them

4.en: and blue, and purple, and scarlet dye

5.en: and the skins of tanned rams
and the wood of the acacia-tree;

6.en: and spices for the anointing oil

7.en: and stones for setting — for the breastpiece and for the vestment.

8.ja: ויצנעו לי מן גמיע ד'אלך מקדסא
8.en: And they shall make for Me, from all of these, a sanctuary
and I shall settle My light in their midst.

9.en: According to all that I am showing you
of the form of the tabernacle
and the form of all its vessels

10.en: And they shall make a chest of acacia wood
two cubits and a half its length
and a cubit and a half its width
and a cubit and a half its height.

11.ja: וג'שה בד'הב כ'אלץ. מן דאכ'ל ומן כ'ארג'
11.en: And overlay it with pure gold — from within it and from without it
11.he: וְצִפִּיתָ אֹתוֹ זָהָב טָהוֹר מִבַּיִת וּמִחוּץ תְּצַפֶּנּוּ

11.ja: ואצנע עלי'ה. זיגא מן ד'הב מסתדירא
11.en: and make upon it a rim of gold, going around.

12.ja: וצג' לה ארבע חלק מן ד'הב
12.en: And cast for it four rings of gold
and place them on its four sides
two rings on the one side
and two rings on the second side.

13.en: And make poles of acacia wood

14.en: And insert the poles into the rings
on the sides of the chest, to carry it by them.
14.he: עַל צַלְעֹת הָאָרֹן לָשֵׂאת אֶת-הָאָרֹן בָּהֶם

15.en: In the rings of the chest shall the poles remain
they shall not be removed from it.

16.en: the testimony which I shall give you.

17.en: And make a cover of pure gold
two cubits and a half its length
and a cubit and a half its width.

18.en: And make two cherubim of gold
from the two ends of the cover.

19.en: And make them: a cherub from this end and a cherub from this end
19.he: וַעֲשֵׂה כְּרוּב אֶחָד מִקָּצָה מִזֶּה וּכְרוּב-אֶחָד מִקָּצָה מִזֶּה

19.ja: מן נפס אלג'שא. תצנע אלכרובין מן טרפיה
19.en: from the cover itself shall you make the cherubim, from its two ends.

20.ja: ויכונא אלכרובין באסטין אגנחתהמא אלי' פוק
20.en: And the cherubim shall be spreading their wings upward
and overshadowing with them the cover

20.ja: ווגוההמא אלואחד אלי' אלאכ'ר. ואלי' אלג'שא
20.en: and the face of the one toward the other, and toward the cover

21.ja: ואגעל אלג'שא. עלי' אלצנדוק מן פוק
21.en: And place the cover upon the chest from above

21.ja: בעד מא תגעל פי אלצנדוק. אלשהאדה אלד'י אעטיכהא
21.en: after you have placed in the chest the testimony which I shall give you.

22.en: And I shall be present there with you

22.ja: וא'כ'אטבך מן פוק אלג'שא. מן בין אלכרובין
22.en: and I shall speak to you from above the cover, from between the two cherubim
22.he: וְדִבַּרְתִּי אִתְּךָ מֵעַל הַכַּפֹּרֶת מִבֵּין שְׁנֵי הַכְּרֻבִים

22.en: which are upon the chest of the testimony

22.ja: בגמיע מא אמרך אלי' בני אסראיל
22.en: with all that I command you to the sons of Israel.
22.he: אֵת כָּל-אֲשֶׁר אֲצַוֶּה אוֹתְךָ אֶל-בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל

23.en: And make a table of acacia wood
two cubits its length, and a cubit its width
and a cubit and a half its height.

24.en: And overlay it with pure gold

24.ja: ואצנע להא. זיגא מן ד'הב מסתדירא
24.en: and make for it a rim of gold, going around.

25.ja: ואצנע להא חאפה. מקדאר קבצ'ה מסתדירא
25.en: And make for it a border, the measure of a handbreadth, going around

25.ja: ואצנע זיגא מן ד'הב. לחאפתהא מסתדירא
25.en: and make a rim of gold for its border, going around.

26.ja: וצג' להא. ארבע חלק מן ד'הב
26.en: And cast for it four rings of gold
and place the rings at its four corners
which are opposite its four legs.

27.en: Facing the border shall the rings be
as a place for the poles, by which to carry it.

28.en: And make the poles of acacia wood
so that the table may be carried by them.

29.en: And make its dishes and its drawers
and its flagons and its ladles
of pure gold shall you make them.

30.ja: ואגעל עלי' אלמאידה. כ'בזא מוגהא בין ידיי דאימא
30.en: And place upon the table bread that is presented before Me continually.
30.he: וְנָתַתָּ עַל-הַשֻּׁלְחָן לֶחֶם פָּנִים לְפָנַי תָּמִיד

31.ja: ואצנע מנארה מן ד'הב כ'אלץ. מצמתה תצנעהא
31.en: And make a lampstand of pure gold — solid shall the lampstand be made
31.he: וְעָשִׂיתָ מְנֹרַת זָהָב טָהוֹר מִקְשָׁה תֵּעָשֶׂה הַמְּנוֹרָה

31.en: and its cups, and its apples and its lilies shall be of it.

32.en: Six branches going out from its sides
three branches from its one side
and three branches from its second side.

33.ja: ת'לאת גאמאת. מלווזאת. פי כל קצבה
33.en: Three almond-shaped cups in each branch
so for the six branches going out from it.

34.en: And in the lampstand itself four almond-shaped cups
with their apples and their lilies.

35.en: And an apple beneath each two branches from it
35.he: וְכַפְתֹּר תַּחַת שְׁנֵי הַקָּנִים מִמֶּנָּה וְכַפְתֹּר תַּחַת שְׁנֵי הַקָּנִים מִמֶּנָּה וְכַפְתֹּר תַּחַת-שְׁנֵי הַקָּנִים מִמֶּנָּה

35.en: so for the six branches going out from it.

36.en: Their apples and their shaft shall be of it

36.ja: כלהא מצמתה ואחדה מן ד'הב כ'אלץ
36.en: all of it one solid piece of pure gold.

37.en: And make for it seven lamps

37.ja: פאד'י תסרג סרגהא. תצ'י אלי' גהה' וגההא
37.en: and when its lamps are lit, they shall give light toward the direction of its face.

38.en: And its tongs and its fire-pans of pure gold.

39.en: From a talent of pure gold shall he make it

46.ja: ואנצ'ר ד'אלך ואצנע כשכלה. אלד'י אנת מורא פי אלגבל
46.en: And look upon it and make it according to its form which you are shown on the mountain.
